scores.evidence: No app tests in ADMIN or MOBILE; eslint exits 1 with 97 errors.
scores.rationale: Only scaffolding (mobile jest) exists; no critical workflow has any automated check.
scores.gaps: No coverage, e2e, or load testing exists to assess.

scores.evidence: Vercel config and env-based secrets exist; no CI, no env validation, no migration workflow, cron fails open.
scores.rationale: Secrets handling is sound but release process has no gates, health check or documented DR.

scores.evidence: No unused deps, zero TODOs, layered lib/; but 2k-line modules, boilerplate README, red lint.
scores.rationale: Structure is reasonable; size and docs gaps raise cost of change.
scores.gaps: No duplication or complexity tooling run.

findings.title: No automated tests in ADMIN (no runner, no test script)
findings.evidence: package.json:5-11 no test script; package.json:13-45 no test framework
findings.impact: Auth, tenant isolation, fees and payments have no regression net across ~180 routes.
findings.recommendation: Add node --test or vitest; start with fee calc, JWT/permission helpers, signature check, two-school isolation fixture.

findings.title: MOBILE jest configured but zero app tests; jest/babel-jest version mismatch
findings.evidence: schoolapp360/package.json jest ~29.7 vs babel-jest ^30.5; jest.config.js testMatch unscoped; no tests in src/
findings.impact: npm test verifies nothing; first real test may break on toolchain mismatch.
findings.recommendation: Align babel-jest to 29, add roots to src, add authSlice/baseApi/utils tests.

findings.title: ESLint baseline red: 97 errors, 35 warnings
findings.evidence: npx eslint . exit 1: set-state-in-effect 47, no-unescaped-entities 42, purity 4; eslint.config.mjs:1-16
findings.impact: Lint cannot gate CI; real hook issues buried.
findings.recommendation: Fix unescaped entities mechanically, triage set-state-in-effect, then enforce in CI.

findings.title: DB-mutating ad-hoc scripts tracked at repo root
findings.impact: Accidental run against a production DATABASE_URL could reset data.
findings.recommendation: Move to scripts/dev-only with a localhost-host guard, or delete.

findings.title: No CI/CD gates in either repo
findings.evidence: no .github directory in ADMIN or MOBILE; package.json:5-11
findings.impact: Broken or insecure code deploys unchecked; about 100 uncommitted modified files obscure release provenance.
findings.recommendation: GitHub Actions: npm ci, lint, prisma validate, next build with dummy env, tests; protect main.

findings.title: Cron endpoints fail open when CRON_SECRET is unset
findings.impact: If unset in production, anyone can trigger mass fee generation or cleanup; var is absent from local .env.
findings.recommendation: Reject when the secret is missing: if (!s || header !== 'Bearer ' + s) return 401.

findings.title: No env validation, no ADMIN .env.example, localhost URL fallback
findings.impact: Misconfigured deploy boots then fails at first login/payment or emails localhost links.
findings.recommendation: Startup env check in instrumentation.js and a names-only .env.example.

findings.title: No error tracking, structured logging or health endpoint in ADMIN
findings.evidence: package.json:13-45 no Sentry/pino; no app/api/health; 30 console.* calls
findings.impact: Production errors and failed crons visible only in platform logs; no uptime probe target.

findings.title: Migrations manual with single baseline; no backup/DR evidence
findings.evidence: prisma/migrations only 20260830172048_init; package.json:8 build lacks migrate deploy; schema.prisma:20 no directUrl
findings.impact: Possible drift between DB and migration history; no documented recovery from data loss.
findings.recommendation: Explicit migrate deploy release step, confirm provider PITR, restore runbook.

findings.title: Login rate limit stored in process memory
findings.impact: Per-instance counters reset on cold start, weakening brute-force throttling on serverless.
findings.recommendation: Persist attempts in Postgres keyed by ip+email.

findings.title: No security headers; empty next.config
findings.evidence: next.config.mjs:1-5; no CSP/HSTS/X-Frame-Options in middleware or lib
findings.recommendation: Add headers() with frame-ancestors, nosniff, Referrer-Policy.

findings.title: dev.log, PDFs and scratch scripts tracked in git
findings.evidence: git ls-files: dev.log (505 lines, no secret keywords matched), AUDIT_REPORT.pdf, ISSUE_CHECKLIST.pdf
findings.impact: Repo noise and future log leakage risk.
findings.recommendation: Untrack dev.log and add *.log to .gitignore (owner decision).

findings.title: Mobile release assets (keystore, eas.json, firebase files) exist only locally
findings.evidence: eas.json, google-services.json, keystore-backup/, firebase admin file untracked (git ls-files / check-ignore); MOB-002
findings.impact: Machine loss means loss of the signing keystore and source; service-account file in project folder is a leak risk.
findings.recommendation: Private remote for source; keystore in EAS plus offline copy; move Firebase admin key out of project dir.

findings.title: Oversized modules: lib/api.js 2181 lines, lib/fees.js 1728
findings.impact: Merge conflicts, slow review, hard-to-test money logic.
findings.recommendation: Split per domain with re-exports; extract pure fee calculators first.

findings.title: README is boilerplate; no env/deploy/runbook docs
findings.evidence: README.md (36 lines create-next-app text); no .env.example; only docs/API-Spec.md
findings.impact: Onboarding and incident response depend on one person.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite README: setup, env names, deploy, migrations, crons.

findings.title: xlsx installed from vendor CDN tarball
findings.impact: Installs depend on cdn.sheetjs.com; npm audit cannot track it; parses user uploads.
findings.recommendation: Keep; cache tarball in CI; keep upload size caps.

findings.title: Process-local globalThis/Map state used as stores
findings.impact: State not shared across serverless instances; shared across requests within one.
findings.recommendation: Keep globalThis only for Prisma client; move other state to DB.

findings.title: Convention notes: deprecated middleware file, raw img tags

notAssessed: Vercel project settings, DB provider backups/PITR, TLS/domain - no access
EAS credentials and store configuration - no access
npm audit / CVE and license scan - not run in this pass
Mobile jest execution - no app tests exist
Duplication and complexity metrics - no tooling run
